body.x: "The Little Big Radio". It's small but the speaker produces a surprising full range of audio on AM and FM or with MP3 files.
It covers the AM and FM bands, plus it has an input jack for audio devices. FM, as well as AM, sounds superb when listening to a strong local station.
Voice replication is clear and precise while delivering natural sounding vocals. This is accomplished with an additional passive radiator speaker.

Its compact size makes it perfect for a small space like a desk or bathroom. This is C. Crane’s first radio that was specifically developed for high fidelity audio. Aux input for smart-phones and players.
